svg.aria-label: Moonglade under a crescent moon: the expanded notch panel listing three live coding agent sessions, and below the wordmark the collapsed bar with a braille spinner and count for running sessions, a green dot and count for sessions waiting at the prompt, and a count and red dot for sessions that need you
svg.title: Moonglade

g.text: Know when your coding agents need you — without leaving the notch.
